propositions: Command syntax is fragmented across argparse parsers, imperative argv loops, hand-maintained help files, and intercept descriptions, allowing parser, runtime help, and documentation to disagree.

All registered command grammars must be produced by one side-effect-free argparse factory consumed at runtime, with no duplicate imperative parsers, doc-only grammars, or second parser frameworks remaining.

Generated package help and grouped overview must be byte-deterministic and current, with every canonical visible command appearing exactly once and serving generated bytes before operation/config/store/handler boundaries.

Parser migrations must preserve accepted/rejected argv parity, diagnostics, streams, and exit codes relative to production baseline, with execution remaining routed through the existing compatibility ladder.
